slug: 2026-04-15 Microsoft secures land for future South Africa data centre growth

facts.fact: Joburg ETC (via MyBroadband) states Microsoft's prior spending established enterprise-grade data centres in Johannesburg and Cape Town, and that capacity will grow across its existing local data centre regions; no launch date given (date is the article's published date).
